text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has managed to leave<n>quite a mark
on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully<n>navigated the crucial
first three years<n>of her career.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've passed a significant<n>milestone, haven't
we?
choice_data_list: I'm glad we made it through!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Trainer? It seems you've been<n>moved to tears
yet again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You've been a leaky faucet ever<n>since the Arima
Kinen. There, there. ♪

By the way, there's something I<n>would like you to
see once you've<n>finished wiping your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, do you remember the promise I<n>wrote out for
you when we were<n>getting started?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to present you with a<n>favorite poem of
mine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, Grass Wonder<n>hands me a sheet
of paper.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I open it up to see the warmest,<n>gentlest brush
strokes of calligraphy I<n>have ever seen. The poem
reads...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When spring comes again, and the<n>years bring us
back here, may this<n>day return. Let us share a
joyous<n>drink—with plum petals in our hair.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some delicious tea, so let's<n>celebrate
spring together each year.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And please, continue to walk this path<n>with me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We've still got a long, long way to go<n>together!
